thread.title: Rep. Ugaste calls for unity ahead of Illinois budget address
thread.title_full: Rep. Ugaste calls for unity ahead of Illinois budget address

author: V. M. Drummond
title: Rep. Ugaste calls for unity ahead of Illinois budget address
text:
At a press conference in Springfield, Illinois State Representative Dan Ugaste joined other House Republicans to discuss the upcoming State Budget Address by Governor J.B. Pritzker. During his remarks, Ugaste called on the governor to reduce divisive language and focus on leadership.
“I urged the Governor to tone down the divisive rhetoric and demonstrate real leadership in helping to move Illinois in the right direction,” Ugaste said at the event.
Ugaste, a Republican, has represented Illinois’ 65th House District since 2019 after succeeding Steven Andersson.
